# pkc/types

> pkc: type expressions, constraints with type variables, struct layout (port of types.go).

truck [pkc](../pkc.md) · [source](../../../registry/pkc/types.pkg)

Types are canonical strings (`int`, `ptr Node`, `[u8]`, `fn(int) -> str`,
`?`). Constraints
in patterns may add type variables (`T`) and slot references (`{slot}`);
a `TyBinder` matches them as slots are parsed and fills results in.

## Library code

Merged into every program that uses this package.

```
struct Ty
  kind: str
  name: str
  elem: ptr Ty
  // fn: parameters (ptr Ty), the result (null if none), and whether the
  // parameters are "..." (any, in constraints)
  params: ptr Vec
  ret: ptr Ty
  anyp: bool
end

fn ty_new(kind: str, name: str, elem: ptr Ty) -> ptr Ty
  let t = new Ty
  t.kind = kind
  t.name = name
  t.elem = elem
  t.params = vec_new()
  return t
end

// ty_fn_type renders the type of a function with these parameter types
// (strs) and result type ("" for none).
fn ty_fn_type(params: ptr Vec, ret: str) -> str
  let s = u_cat3("fn(", u_join(params, ", "), ")")
  if ret != ""
    s = u_cat3(s, " -> ", ret)
  end
  return s
end

fn ty_is_fn(t: str) -> bool
  return str_starts(t, "fn(")
end

// ty_fn_parts splits a function type into its parameter types (pushed to
// params) and result type.
fn ty_fn_parts(t: str, params: ptr Vec, ret: ptr str) -> bool
  let saved = pk_err
  let ft = ty_parse(t)
  pk_err = saved
  if ft == null || ft.kind != "fn" || ft.anyp
    return false
  end
  for i = 0 to vec_len(ft.params) - 1
    u_push(params, ty_string(vec_get(ft.params, i) as ptr Ty))
  end
  *ret = ""
  if ft.ret != null
    *ret = ty_string(ft.ret)
  end
  return true
end

// ty_parse_fn reads the rest of a function type after "fn(".
fn ty_parse_fn(s: str, rest: ptr str) -> ptr Ty
  let t = ty_new("fn", "", null)
  let r = ty_trim_left(s)
  if str_starts(r, "...)")
    t.anyp = true
    r = str_slice(r, 4, len(r))
  elif str_starts(r, ")")
    r = str_slice(r, 1, len(r))
  else
    while true
      let after = ""
      let p = ty_parse_prefix(r, &after)
      if p == null
        return null
      end
      vec_push(t.params, p as int)
      after = ty_trim_left(after)
      if str_starts(after, ",")
        r = str_slice(after, 1, len(after))
        continue
      end
      if !str_starts(after, ")")
        u_fail("missing ')' in function type")
        return null
      end
      r = str_slice(after, 1, len(after))
      break
    end
  end
  let r2 = ty_trim_left(r)
  if str_starts(r2, "->")
    let after = ""
    let ret = ty_parse_prefix(str_slice(r2, 2, len(r2)), &after)
    if ret == null
      return null
    end
    t.ret = ret
    r = after
  end
  *rest = r
  return t
end

// ty_is_null: is t null's type, ptr ?
fn ty_is_null(t: ptr Ty) -> bool
  return t.kind == "ptr" && t.elem.kind == "wild"
end

fn ty_trim_left(s: str) -> str
  let i = 0
  while i < len(s) && s[i] == ' '
    i = i + 1
  end
  return str_slice(s, i, len(s))
end

fn ty_word_char(c: u8) -> bool
  return c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '_'
end

// ty_parse_prefix parses a type at the start of s; *rest is what follows.
fn ty_parse_prefix(s0: str, rest: ptr str) -> ptr Ty
  let s = ty_trim_left(s0)
  if s == ""
    u_fail("missing type")
    return null
  end
  if s[0] == '?'
    *rest = str_slice(s, 1, len(s))
    return ty_new("wild", "", null)
  end
  if s[0] == '['
    let after = ""
    let elem = ty_parse_prefix(str_slice(s, 1, len(s)), &after)
    if elem == null
      return null
    end
    after = ty_trim_left(after)
    if !str_starts(after, "]")
      u_fail("missing ']' in type")
      return null
    end
    *rest = str_slice(after, 1, len(after))
    return ty_new("slice", "", elem)
  end
  if s[0] == '{'
    let stop = str_find_byte(s, '}', 0)
    if stop < 0
      u_fail("missing '}' in type")
      return null
    end
    *rest = str_slice(s, stop + 1, len(s))
    return ty_new("slot", u_trim(str_slice(s, 1, stop)), null)
  end
  if str_starts(s, "fn(")
    return ty_parse_fn(str_slice(s, 3, len(s)), rest)
  end
  let stop = 0
  while stop < len(s) && ty_word_char(s[stop])
    stop = stop + 1
  end
  if stop == 0
    u_fail(u_cat3("unexpected ", u_quote(s), " in type"))
    return null
  end
  let word = str_slice(s, 0, stop)
  let after = str_slice(s, stop, len(s))
  if word == "ptr"
    let elem = ty_parse_prefix(after, rest)
    if elem == null
      return null
    end
    return ty_new("ptr", "", elem)
  elif word == "any"
    *rest = after
    return ty_new("wild", "", null)
  elif len(word) == 1 && word[0] >= 'A' && word[0] <= 'Z'
    *rest = after
    return ty_new("var", word, null)
  end
  *rest = after
  return ty_new("name", word, null)
end

fn ty_parse(s: str) -> ptr Ty
  let rest = ""
  let t = ty_parse_prefix(u_trim(s), &rest)
  if t == null
    return null
  end
  if u_trim(rest) != ""
    u_fail(u_cat4("unexpected ", u_quote(rest), " in type ", u_quote(s)))
    return null
  end
  return t
end

fn ty_string(t: ptr Ty) -> str
  if t.kind == "ptr"
    return u_cat("ptr ", ty_string(t.elem))
  elif t.kind == "slice"
    return u_cat3("[", ty_string(t.elem), "]")
  elif t.kind == "wild"
    return "?"
  elif t.kind == "slot"
    return u_cat3("{", t.name, "}")
  elif t.kind == "fn"
    let ps = vec_new()
    for i = 0 to vec_len(t.params) - 1
      u_push(ps, ty_string(vec_get(t.params, i) as ptr Ty))
    end
    if t.anyp
      ps = vec_new()
      u_push(ps, "...")
    end
    let ret = ""
    if t.ret != null
      ret = ty_string(t.ret)
    end
    return ty_fn_type(ps, ret)
  end
  return t.name
end

fn ty_unify(a: ptr Ty, b: ptr Ty) -> bool
  if a.kind == "wild" || b.kind == "wild"
    return true
  end
  if ty_is_null(a) && b.kind == "fn" || ty_is_null(b) && a.kind == "fn"
    return true
  end
  if a.kind != b.kind || a.name != b.name
    return false
  end
  if a.kind == "fn"
    if vec_len(a.params) != vec_len(b.params) || (a.ret == null) != (b.ret == null)
      return false
    end
    for i = 0 to vec_len(a.params) - 1
      if !ty_unify(vec_get(a.params, i) as ptr Ty, vec_get(b.params, i) as ptr Ty)
        return false
      end
    end
    return a.ret == null || ty_unify(a.ret, b.ret)
  end
  if a.elem != null
    return ty_unify(a.elem, b.elem)
  end
  return true
end

// ty_compatible: can a value of type got be used where want is expected
fn ty_compatible(want: str, got: str) -> bool
  if want == got
    return true
  end
  let a = ty_parse(want)
  let b = ty_parse(got)
  return a != null && b != null && ty_unify(a, b)
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- binder

// A TyBinder belongs to one node being matched: vars binds type
// variables, and slot references look at that node's slots as they are
// now (through ps_slot_type in pkc/parser).
struct TyBinder
  vars: ptr Map
  node: int
end

fn ty_binder(node: int) -> ptr TyBinder
  let b = new TyBinder
  b.vars = map_new()
  b.node = node
  return b
end

fn ty_slot_type(b: ptr TyBinder, name: str, ok: ptr bool) -> str
  return ps_slot_type(b.node, name, ok)
end

fn ty_match(b: ptr TyBinder, pat: ptr Ty, actual: ptr Ty) -> bool
  if actual.kind == "wild"
    if pat.kind == "var" && !map_has(b.vars, pat.name)
      map_set(b.vars, pat.name, actual as int)
    end
    return true
  end
  if pat.kind == "wild"
    return true
  elif pat.kind == "var"
    if map_has(b.vars, pat.name)
      return ty_unify(map_get(b.vars, pat.name) as ptr Ty, actual)
    end
    map_set(b.vars, pat.name, actual as int)
    return true
  elif pat.kind == "slot"
    let ok = false
    let s = ty_slot_type(b, pat.name, &ok)
    if !ok
      return true
    end
    let t = ty_parse(s)
    return t != null && ty_unify(t, actual)
  elif pat.kind == "name"
    return actual.kind == "name" && actual.name == pat.name
  elif pat.kind == "ptr" || pat.kind == "slice"
    return actual.kind == pat.kind && ty_match(b, pat.elem, actual.elem)
  elif pat.kind == "fn"
    if actual.kind != "fn"
      return false
    end
    if !pat.anyp
      if vec_len(pat.params) != vec_len(actual.params)
        return false
      end
      for i = 0 to vec_len(pat.params) - 1
        if !ty_match(b, vec_get(pat.params, i) as ptr Ty, vec_get(actual.params, i) as ptr Ty)
          return false
        end
      end
    end
    if pat.ret == null
      return pat.anyp || actual.ret == null
    end
    if actual.ret == null
      // fn(...) -> R on a function without a result: R is no value
      if pat.ret.kind == "var"
        if map_has(b.vars, pat.ret.name)
          let bound = map_get(b.vars, pat.ret.name) as ptr Ty
          return bound.kind == "name" && bound.name == ""
        end
        map_set(b.vars, pat.ret.name, ty_new("name", "", null) as int)
        return true
      end
      return false
    end
    return ty_match(b, pat.ret, actual.ret)
  end
  return false
end

// ty_matches checks a constraint against an actual type; *bad is set if
// the constraint itself doesn't parse.
fn ty_matches(b: ptr TyBinder, constraint: str, actual: str, bad: ptr bool) -> bool
  *bad = false
  if constraint == "" || constraint == "any"
    return true
  end
  let pat = ty_parse(constraint)
  if pat == null
    *bad = true
    return false
  end
  if actual == ""
    return false
  end
  let got = ty_parse(actual)
  if got == null
    *bad = true
    return false
  end
  return ty_match(b, pat, got)
end

fn ty_subst_walk(b: ptr TyBinder, t: ptr Ty) -> ptr Ty
  if t.kind == "var"
    if map_has(b.vars, t.name)
      return map_get(b.vars, t.name) as ptr Ty
    end
    return ty_new("wild", "", null)
  elif t.kind == "slot"
    let ok = false
    let s = ty_slot_type(b, t.name, &ok)
    if !ok
      u_fail(u_cat3("result type names slot {", t.name, "}, which is missing"))
      return null
    end
    if s == ""
      return ty_new("name", "", null)
    end
    return ty_parse(s)
  elif t.kind == "ptr" || t.kind == "slice"
    let e = ty_subst_walk(b, t.elem)
    if e == null
      return null
    end
    return ty_new(t.kind, "", e)
  elif t.kind == "fn"
    let out = ty_new("fn", "", null)
    out.anyp = t.anyp
    for i = 0 to vec_len(t.params) - 1
      let w = ty_subst_walk(b, vec_get(t.params, i) as ptr Ty)
      if w == null
        return null
      end
      vec_push(out.params, w as int)
    end
    if t.ret != null
      let w = ty_subst_walk(b, t.ret)
      if w == null
        return null
      end
      out.ret = w
    end
    return out
  end
  return t
end

// ty_subst fills variables and slot references into a result type; it
// returns false (with pk_err set) on an error.
fn ty_subst(b: ptr TyBinder, result: str, out: ptr str) -> bool
  let t = ty_parse(result)
  if t == null
    return false
  end
  let r = ty_subst_walk(b, t)
  if r == null
    return false
  end
  *out = ty_string(r)
  return true
end

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- layout

struct TyStruct
  name: str
  fields: ptr Vec
  size: int
end

struct TyField
  name: str
  ty: str
  offset: int
end

struct Types
  prims: ptr Map
  structs: ptr Map
end

fn ty_struct(ts: ptr Types, name: str) -> ptr TyStruct
  return map_get(ts.structs, name) as ptr TyStruct
end

fn ty_field(s: ptr TyStruct, name: str) -> ptr TyField
  for i = 0 to vec_len(s.fields) - 1
    let f = vec_get(s.fields, i) as ptr TyField
    if f.name == name
      return f
    end
  end
  return null
end

// ty_size: bytes a value of type t takes in a field or slice element;
// -1 with pk_err set if t has no size.
fn ty_size(ts: ptr Types, t: str) -> int
  if str_starts(t, "ptr ") || str_starts(t, "[") || t == "?" || ty_is_fn(t)
    return 8
  end
  if map_has(ts.prims, t)
    return map_get(ts.prims, t)
  end
  if ty_struct(ts, t) != null
    u_fail(u_cat4("struct ", t, " can only be used through a pointer (ptr ", u_cat(t, ")")))
    return -1
  end
  u_fail(u_cat("unknown type ", t))
  return -1
end

fn ty_elem(t: str) -> str
  if str_starts(t, "ptr ")
    return str_slice(t, 4, len(t))
  elif str_starts(t, "[") && str_ends(t, "]")
    return str_slice(t, 1, len(t) - 1)
  elif t == "str"
    return "u8"
  end
  return ""
end

// ty_layout assigns field offsets, each aligned to its size, and rounds
// the struct up to 8 bytes.
fn ty_layout(ts: ptr Types, s: ptr TyStruct) -> bool
  let off = 0
  for i = 0 to vec_len(s.fields) - 1
    let f = vec_get(s.fields, i) as ptr TyField
    let size = ty_size(ts, f.ty)
    if size < 0
      return u_fail(u_cat4("field ", f.name, " of ", u_cat3(s.name, ": ", pk_err)))
    end
    off = (off + size - 1) / size * size
    f.offset = off
    off = off + size
  end
  s.size = (off + 7) & -8
  if s.size == 0
    s.size = 8
  end
  return true
end
```
